replication.target_description: Study 2 main effect of hand wipe on moral emotions in the 2 × 2 × 2 between-subjects ANOVA, printed p. 26. The supplied p. 7 locator points to printed p. 27, whose discussion also identifies this outcome.

n.sample_role: Participants; exact moral-emotion critical-model analytic N is not explicitly established. Recruitment N = 119; candidate retained N = 115.
n.exclusions: Four procedural exclusions: own antiseptic cream, premature wipe use, declining wipe use, and no unethical story. Outcome-specific missingness is not documented.
n.location: Printed p. 25, Study 2 Participants and footnote 1; p. 26, Results and Discussion and Table 1
n.quote:
Participants consisted of 119 undergraduates from Kwantlen Polytechnic University
who participated in exchange for partial course credit in psychology courses. Four
participants’ data could not be used due to their failure to comply with the experimental
procedure.1

notes:
Identity independently checked: full primary article Is cleanliness next to godliness? Dispelling old wives’ tales: Failure to replicate Zhong and Liljenquist (2006), by Jennifer V. Fayard, Amandeep K. Bassi, Daniel M. Bernstein and Brent W. Roberts; JASNH 2009 Vol. 6 No. 2, printed pp. 21–29, including methods, results, references and receipt dates. Title, authors and journal match the assigned replication reference. No DOI is printed or assigned. This is the primary report of its two studies, not a secondary article or preregistration. No PDF was supplied. Only assigned unfinished fields assessed; all remaining fields are unassigned placeholders. Moral-emotion target evidence: Regarding the reduction of moral emotions, ANOVA revealed no significant main effects
                   for hand wipe F (1, 107) = .01, p = .93, ηp2 = .00, nor for the added conditions. Candidate volunteering final-group total: 15 + 14 + 15 + 13 + 15 + 13 + 15 + 15 = 115 participants in eight mutually exclusive factorial cells. Recruitment arithmetic: 119 - 4 = 115. Neither explicitly establishes the moral-emotion critical-model analytic N; n.value remains null. Table 1 is expressly labelled Amount of Time Volunteered (In Minutes), a different outcome. Candidate common-model N is retained for parent field-scope review. No N is inferred from degrees of freedom. The two original replication conditions each have 15 participants in the volunteering table; their sum 30 does not represent the full factorial main-effect sample.
